title: Organic Pest Control Secrets Revealed
reason: The video describes a 80-year-old farmer's method of pest control without pesticides.

tasks.task: Describe the organic pest control methods used by the farmer.

subtasks.text: Observe the method of using one orange peel soaked in water to treat small flying insects.
Notice the use of white vinegar mixed with dish soap to deal with sticky bugs.
Highlight the process of diluting laundry detergent with water to combat red spiders.
See the method of boiling Sichuan pepper to make a solution to eliminate beetles.
Observe the mixture of chili and garlic water to deal with cabbage worms.
Pay attention to the boiling of Artemisia mugwort in water to prevent ground beetles.
